description:
Roster Board is the shift calendar built by a shift worker, for shift workers. Your roster, overtime, pay, leave and life outside work, all in one place.

YOUR ROSTER, AT A GLANCE
• Colour-coded calendar with your own shift types: days, nights, training, anything
• Start and finish times work out your hours automatically
• Build your rotation once, then fill your calendar for a year in one tap
• Full-time or part-time, your hours are tracked the right way

NEVER SLEEP THROUGH A SHIFT
• Set an alarm on any shift type, from 15 minutes to 3 hours before it starts
• Add up to two alerts to your appointments and events, up to a week ahead
• Real alarms that ring like the Clock app, even on silent (iOS 26 or later)

SEE YOUR FAMILY AND FRIENDS' ROSTERS
• Share your roster with your partner, family, friends or workmates
• See who's working when, without the back-and-forth
• Your pay is never shared, and you choose whether your events are

OVERTIME AND EXCESS HOURS
• Log overtime and excess hours on the shift you worked them
• Monthly and yearly totals for ordinary hours, excess and overtime

SHIFT SWAPS
• Record every swap, who it was with and when
• Your calendar and hours update to match

KNOW YOUR PAY BEFORE PAYDAY
• Enter your hourly rate and pay cycle once
• Set your own overtime, excess and penalty rates
• See your estimated pay for each week, fortnight, month or year

REPORTS
• Hours by shift type
• Weekdays vs weekends
• Compare this month with last month
• Export a clean PDF of your roster to print or share

LEAVE, EVENTS AND BIRTHDAYS
• Annual and sick leave on the same calendar
• Appointments, reminders and social events alongside your shifts
• Birthdays from your contacts appear automatically, so you never miss one

MAKE IT YOURS
• Pick a colour, icon and border for every shift type
• Light and dark mode
• Sign in to back up automatically and use Roster Board on all your devices

ROSTER BOARD PREMIUM
Free includes the calendar, up to 3 shift types, overtime and excess, leave, events, birthdays, reminders and cloud backup. Premium unlocks roster sharing, alarms, unlimited shift types, roster patterns, pay estimates, full reports and PDF export. Choose a monthly subscription or a one-off lifetime purchase.

promotionalText: New: real alarms before your shifts and events. Plan your roster, track overtime and leave, share rosters with family and see your pay before payday.
reviewNotes:
PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Roster Board is a shift calendar for shift workers (nurses, police, paramedics, mine and factory workers, hospitality and retail staff). Rotating rosters are hard to keep track of in a normal calendar. Roster Board shows shifts, overtime, leave, shift swaps and personal events on one colour-coded calendar, estimates pay before payday, lets workers share rosters with family and workmates, and sets real alarms before shifts.

GETTING STARTED
No account is needed: tap "Use without an account" on the first screen. To test sign-in, sync and account deletion, tap Sign up and use an email address you can receive mail at (a confirmation link is sent). Account deletion: Account > Account > Delete account.
Main features: Types tab (create shift types with times, colour, icon, border and alarm); tap any day to add shifts, leave, swaps and events; Roster tab (build a repeating pattern and fill the calendar); Reports tab (hours, overtime, pay estimate, comparisons, PDF export); Account > Birthdays; Account > Shared rosters.
Roster sharing: create two accounts. On the first, go to Account > Shared rosters and send a request to the second account's email. Accept it on the second account; each can then see the other's roster. Pay is never shared.
Alarms (iOS 26 or later): in Types, edit a shift type and choose an Alarm; or add an event with a time and choose an Alert. Scheduled on the device with AlarmKit. Without Premium, or before iOS 26, events offer Remind me instead (a local notification).
Birthdays: with permission, contact names and birthdays are read so birthdays show on the calendar. Nothing else from Contacts is read.

IN-APP PURCHASES
Premium unlocks roster sharing, alarms, unlimited shift types (free allows 3), roster pattern fill, pay estimates, full reports and PDF export. Options: Premium Monthly (auto-renewing, 1 month) and Premium Lifetime (one-off). The purchase screen opens from Account > Premium > Roster Board Premium > Unlock Premium, and whenever a Premium feature is used. It shows each plan's title, length and price, renewal terms and links to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Restore purchases is on the same screen.

EXTERNAL SERVICES
Supabase: accounts, cloud backup and roster sharing. Apple StoreKit: purchases. Apple AlarmKit, UserNotifications and Contacts frameworks: on-device only. No advertising, analytics, tracking or AI services.

REGIONS
The app works the same in all regions. Pay estimates are generic (the user enters their own rates).

REGULATION
Not a regulated industry, and no third-party protected content.
